channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: McCaskill picks up second straight Chargers win at SNMP
item.description: Bradley McCaskill scored his second straight KONI Charger win at Southern National, with Aiden McConnaughey a career-best second and Legends victories split between Levi Canup and Brody Rhodes.

item.title: Downtown prepares for the Warbirds
item.description: Downtown Wilson businesses, events and tourism schedules are shifting as the new Wilson Warbirds ballpark opens, with extended hours, fan deals and a ribbon-cutting set for Saturday.

item.title: Community briefs: Upcoming events include egg hunts and political conv...
item.description: Wilson’s upcoming community events include Easter egg hunts and festivals, a county Democratic convention and free dementia caregiver Zoom sessions.

item.title: Downtown Wilson has new branding
item.description: Folks at Saturday's ArtSpin got a first look at new branding for downtown Wilson.

item.title: Woman charged with burning house
item.description: A Wilson woman was charged with felony burning after a vacant East Vance Street house fire caused nearly total loss.

item.title: Welfare reforms create good problems
item.description: New federal work requirements for Medicaid and SNAP and higher SNAP administrative costs are prompting North Carolina debate on welfare policy and possible work rules for housing assistance.

item.title: Brewers investor seeks majority stake in Warbirds
item.description: Milwaukee Brewers are negotiating to sell a controlling stake in the Wilson Warbirds to longtime investor John A. Canning Jr., while keeping a minority share, pending MLB approval.

item.title: BARTON ROUNDUP: Bulldogs complete series sweep of Chowan
item.description: Barton teams log sweeps, routs and tight losses as baseball earns its first series sweep under new head coach and flag football, tennis, women’s lacrosse and track all roll in a busy weekend roundup.

item.title: Bell urges council, residents to ‘bring down the temperature’
item.description: After heated debate over an ICE-related proposal, Wilson Mayor Pro Tem Michael Bell urges council and residents to lower tensions, stressing respect, honesty and unity as members weigh trust and transparency.

item.title: Area Calendar, March 24-25, 2026
item.description: Area sports calendar for March 24-25, 2026: A full slate of college and high school baseball, softball, soccer, lacrosse, golf, track and more across the region.

item.title: MIDDLE SCHOOL ROUNDUP: Vikings hold hit parade, allow none by Bucks
item.description: Elm City’s middle school teams dominate on the diamond and pitch — with a baseball no-hitter and 7-0 girls soccer shutout — while Vikings boys tennis falls 5-4 to Williamston.

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: Cyclones’ late flurry finishes Bruins
item.description: Community Christian softball’s 21-11 walk-off, Cyclones girls soccer’s 7-1 rematch win, Wilson Christian baseball and soccer setbacks, and Fike tennis’ 7-0 sweep headline Monday’s area prep slate.

item.title: Greenfield’s Edwards earns USA Today All-USA acclaim
item.description: After leading Greenfield to its first NCISAA 2-A title, senior guard Kobe Edwards was named to USA Today’s All-USA East second team, becoming the program’s second All-America pick after Coby White.

item.title: McKenzie’s near no-no sparks Knights in nonconference romp
item.description: Greenfield lefty Zach McKenzie carried a no-hitter into the fifth and finished with a one-hitter and 3 RBIs as the Knights routed Northwood Temple 11-1 in five innings in nonconference play.
